verdict.rationale: Riskified documents fixed, product-defined automations that run in the background once a merchant enables them. These include end-to-end automated chargeback handling through gateway integrations, automatic void/capture/restock and cancellation emails in its Shopify integration, and automated decision notifications with retries. However, there is no evidence of a user-configurable automation builder, custom triggers, or scheduled or agentic workflows that users define themselves. Missing for 10: user-defined automation rules or workflow builder, recurring schedules, custom triggers and actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
